title: mnkr - knew him
html:
Graph connections

Root

  • nkr - wrong

Meaning

knew him · Lemma مُنكِر

Surahs (3)

  • 012 Yusuf
  • 021 Al-Anbya
  • 023 Al-Muminun

Verses (full text)

Arabic + English (Sahih International) + English (Yusuf Ali) + Urdu. Showing up to 10 verses in (web app shows all).

12:58 · 012 Yusuf

وَجَآءَ إِخْوَةُ يُوسُفَ فَدَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَعَرَفَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

Word in this verse: مُنكِرُونَ — knew him not

English (Sahih International): And the brothers of Joseph came [seeking food], and they entered upon him; and he recognized them, but he was to them unknown.

English (Yusuf Ali): Then came Joseph's brethren: they entered his presence, and he knew them, but they knew him not.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): اور یوسف کے بھائی (کنعان سے مصر میں غلّہ خریدنے کے لیے) آئے تو یوسف کے پاس گئے تو یوسف نے ان کو پہچان لیا اور وہ ان کو نہ پہچان سکے

21:50 · 021 Al-Anbya

وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ۚ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

Word in this verse: مُنكِرُونَ — rejecters

English (Sahih International): And this [Qur’ān] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?

English (Yusuf Ali): And this is a blessed Message which We have sent down: will ye then reject it?

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): یہ مبارک نصیحت ہے جسے ہم نے نازل فرمایا ہے تو کیا تم اس سے انکار کرتے ہو؟

23:69 · 023 Al-Muminun

أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

Word in this verse: مُنكِرُونَ — (are) rejecting him

English (Sahih International): Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?

English (Yusuf Ali): Or do they not recognise their Messenger, that they deny him?

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): یا یہ اپنے پیغمبر کو جانتے پہنچانتے نہیں، اس وجہ سے ان کو نہیں مانتے
